purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, source schema, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Punjab Land Records Authority/PULSE material and the first-party ArcGIS service establish a Punjab cadastral-map custodian route. The Sheikhupura district layer returned one complete polygon intersecting the exact WUP point in Muridke Tehsil.
registryAssessment: Local/provincial registry custody found through Government of Punjab PLRA/PULSE sources. The result is service evidence and a point sample, not proof of citywide geometry availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal describes Punjab digital land-record services and ARC network.
Official PULSE project page describes parcel mapping and cadastral-map linkage objectives.
Official public GIS viewer; page disclaimer says property lines are indicative and not for legal boundary use.
First-party ArcGIS MapServer lists district polygon layers, including Sheikhupura (layer 31), and reports Web Mercator service extent.

viewerConfiguration.tokenRoute: /api/gis/token (anonymous viewer bootstrap; token value not retained)
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Layer metadata: source spatial reference WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857; output query requested outSR=4326. Native field metadata was inspected but raw attributes were not retained in the sample.
safeFieldAllowlist: non-personal administrative fields for qualification only

attempts.result: HTTP 200 HTML retrieved. Viewer JavaScript exposed the anonymous token bootstrap route and first-party ArcGIS service URLs.
HTTP 200 JSON returned success/token/expiresAt. Token was used only for the bounded public viewer request and was not retained in packet files.
Without viewer token, HTTP JSON response was ArcGIS error 499 Token Required. This was an access-control observation, not a failure of the service.
HTTP 200 JSON metadata; Sheikhupura layer 31 present with polygon geometry and native OBJECTID field.
HTTP 200 JSON layer metadata; fields and CRS inspected.

Point-intersects query at geometry=74.2567081193507,31.7916104396334, geometryType=esriGeometryPoint, inSR=4326, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=*, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3, f=geojson returned one complete Polygon. Native OBJECTID=3070826; administrative fields identified Muridke Tehsil/Muridke QH/Muridke Zari Mouza. One feature retained after stripping all source attributes except canonical id.

geometryDecision: Retain one full polygon in muridke-parcel-samples.geojson. It has exactly one canonical property: {"id":"3070826"}. No raw source attribute set is retained.

geometryEvidence.query: Exact WUP point intersects one feature in Sheikhupura layer 31; output requested EPSG:4326.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Punjab PULSE/PLRA cadastral-map service with district layers.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public viewer bootstrap, service metadata, and one anonymous point-bounded ID-plus-polygon response.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point hit is not a citywide survey. PULSE labels property lines indicative and not legal boundaries. OBJECTID is the service's native OID and is retained as the canonical identity, but parcel identity persistence/versioning was not independently established. Runtime adapter qualification remains held.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Serial reviewer must independently qualify service behavior and identity mapping before runtime admission; this packet alone does not enable an adapter.
